sentence: Driven by a progressive hardening and rigidity, Conium Maculatum is engaged in a slow descent from sexual vitality into physical and mental paralysis, moving through desire, suppression, indifference, and complete shutdown.
references: Herscu, P. ND, DHANP & Ryan, C. MD. 'The Cycle of Conium maculatum.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, vol 6 #1.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Sexual vitality and desire
segments.description: Heightened sexual desire, increased appetite for stimulation. Excessive libido, erotic thoughts. Nervous excitement.

segments.name: Suppression and control
segments.description: Attempt to control and suppress the sexual energy. Mind over body. Moral rigidity, shame, ascetic tendencies. Conflicts between desire and duty.

segments.name: Indifference and apathy
segments.description: Loss of sexual interest, general indifference. Apathy toward life, toward loved ones. Emotional flatness. No joy in anything.

segments.name: Physical rigidity and paralysis
segments.description: Progressive hardening and stiffness. Muscles rigid, joints stiff. Trembling, weakness, gradual paralysis. Worse touch, worse exertion. Tumors, induration, glandular enlargement.

segments.name: Mental dullness and confusion
segments.description: Mental faculties decline: confusion, forgetfulness, difficulty concentrating. Depression, weeping without cause. Aversion to mental work. Memory fails. Dullness of mind.
